items.title: Warrant list
Minutes
Contracts and claims settlements list
Resolution to approve Amendment One to the County Incentive Grant Program for construction of intersection improvements at SR-809/Military Trail and Forest Hill Blvd.

Amendment No. 3 with the Area Agency on Aging of Palm Beach/Treasure Coast, Inc. for the Emergency Home Energy Assistance for the Elderly Program amend, revise and replace portions of the agreement and increase the overall total funding; and approve a Budget Amendment.

Partial Notice of Award No. 5 from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services for new and existing programs for clients with HIV/AIDS; final Notice of Award No. 6; a partial Notice of Award No. 5; Notice of Award No. 6; delegate authority to County Administrator and approve Budget Amendment.
Modification to Emergency Rental Assistance Program 2 from the U.S. Department of the Treasury to increase funding.
Approve Amendment No. 1 with Alzheimer's Community Care, Inc. to extend the end date, and to amend, revise and replace portions of the agreement; and to increase the overall funding.
Approve the appointment of new member to the Homeless Advisory Board.
PBI Operating Permit with IBC Airways, Inc. for an operated flight.
PBI Operating Permit with Global Crossing Airlines, Inc. for an operated flight.
Amendment No. 11 with The Morganti Group, Inc. for PBI exercising the final one year renewal option.
Resolution establishing a standard form Unmanned Aircraft System Activity Permit authorizing County Administrator or designee to execute the Permit.
Budget Amendment to establish the budget for the bond proceeds, costs of insurance and project costs in the 47.315M NAV Pub Imp Rev Bond, Series 2023C.
Negotiated settlement offer for the full satisfaction of a code enforcement lien.
First Amendment to Standard License Agreement for Use of County-Owned Property adjacent to the County Stockade located at 9620 Weisman Way for parking.
Standard License Agreement for Use of County-Owned Property for West County Senior Center and Judicial Center Parking Garage/Governmental Center Parking Garage.
Zero-dollar value Change Order No. 15 Contingency Use Directive No. 7 reflecting a decrease in the amount with Kaufman Lynn Construction, Inc. for the Canyon District Park project.
Amendment No. 1 with Urban Design Studio, LLC to reduce the Small Business Enterprise participation commitment due to Urban Design Studio, LLC has successfully completed the County's SBE program.
Approve Contract with REG Architect's, Inc. to provide professional architectural/engineering services for the Brooks Subdivision project.
Approval annual contract with Advanced Painting Contractors, Inc. for painting and weatherproofing services.
Amendment 001 with the Town of Mangonia Park extending the completion date.
Executed documents in connection with a loan under the Housing and Urban Development Section 108 Loan Program.
Request for Release of Funds and Certification for an environmental review conducted on behalf of The Lord's Place.
Certification By State of Local Official of PHA Plans Consistency with the Consolidated Plan or State Consolidated Plan for Palm Beach County Housing Authority.
Agreements with City of Riviera Beach for the development of a new Playground and continued development of Phase II of the Urban Farm projects.
HOME Investment Partnership Program Loan Agreement with Autumn Ridge Apartments, Ltd; and ARPA Response Replacement Fund Loan Agreement.
Interlocal Agreement with the Village of Royal Palm Beach providing for the annexation of an enclave known as Sunset Isles Condominiums.
Reappointment of two members to the Building Code Advisory Board.
Work Order No. 4 with Rangeline Tapping Services, Inc. for the Line Stop Fittings for Emergency Services project.
Consultant Services Authorization No. 9 with Holtz Consulting Engineering, Inc. for the Kings Point Water and Sewer Condition Assessment project.
Change Order No. 3 with All Webbs Enterprises, Inc. for the Upper Floridan Aquifer Well Rehabilitation contract for contract time extension.
Supplement No. 1 with Globaltech, Inc. for the Water Treatment Plant No. 8 Process Improvements, Design, Permitting, and Bidding Services.
Change Order No. 2 to the State of Florida, Department of Environmental Protection Agreement for a budget reallocation in the South Lake Worth Inlet Management Plan Implementation project.
Emergency Services Agreement for Mutual Assistance and Automatic Aid with the City of Coconut Creek for a period of ten years.
Emergency Medical Services County Grant Award Letter to improve and expand the EMS system; and approve a Budget Amendment.
Amendment to the Miami UASI Budget Amendment Form attachment of the Memorandum of Agreement FY2021 with the City of Miami to receive reimbursable grant funding.

Amendment to Attachment A of the State-funded Grant Agreement for Emergency Management Preparedness and Assistance Grant with State of Florida, Division of Emergency Management to receive grant funding to improve and enhance emergency management plans and programs; and to provide operational support for such programs for July 2022 through June 2023.

Amendment to Attachment A of the federally-funded Grant Agreement for Emergency Management Preparedness and Assistance Grant with the State of Florida, Division of Emergency Management to receive grant funding to improve and enhance emergency management plans and programs; and to provide operational support for such programs for October 2022 through September 2023.
Approve Amendment 1 to contract with Drug Abuse Treatment Association, Inc. and Amendment 2 to contract with Drug Abuse Foundation of Palm Beach County, Inc.
Contract with Legal Aid Society of Palm Beach County, Inc. to provide civil legal services to indigent citizens of Palm Beach County; and authorize County Administrator or designee.

Adopt a resolution approving Public Transportation Grant Agreement with the State of Florida Department of Transportation to provide assistance for the purchase of Transit Signal Priority equipment and installation; and approve Budget Amendment.
First Amendment to Tri-Party Agreement with the City of Boca Raton and ESPN Productions, Inc. to extend the Agreement for one three-year term.
Executed peer review agreement with Association of Local Government Auditors to conduct peer review of the County Internal Auditor's Office quality control system.
US Department of Agriculture's Urban Agriculture and Innovative Production program grant application.
US Environmental Protection Agency Environmental Justice Government to Government program grant application.

First reading and permission to advertise for adoption hearing on July 11, 2023 a resolution of findings and designating real property located at 8760 Atlantic Avenue as a Brownfield Area for the purpose of rehabilitation, job creation and promoting economic development.

Standard Form LLL – Disclosure of Lobbying Activities and filing electronic grant application with FTA; approve Program of Projects for American Rescue Plan Act; and authorize County Administrator or designee.
Presentation on property values and the Property Appraiser's FY24 budget proposal.
American Rescue Plan Act Response Replacement Fund award; approve a Budget Transfer; direct staff to negotiate loan agreements; and authorize County Administrator or designee.
Resolution creating Palm Beach County Veterans Advisory Board.

Amendment No. 1 to Subreceipient Agreement with United Way of Palm Beach County, Inc. to increase the overall total agreement to provide funding assistance for the expansion of hunger relief system in order to increase food bank storage and food processing capacity.
Employment contract with new Internal Auditor
Agreement to purchase vacant land north of Indiantown Road and east of Bee Line Highway from Jorge Rodriguez.
Agreement to purchase vacant land north of Indiantown Road and east of Bee Line Highway Helen Stratton.
Agreement to purchase vacant land north of Indiantown Road and east of Bee Line Highway Philip G. Rathof.
Transit Village Subdivision replat pending condition after approval of City of West Palm Beach, County will hold replat in escrow and recording at closing pursuant to Purchase and Sale Agreement.

source_note: Items and titles transcribed from the official agenda (table of contents or order of business). Agendas list what was scheduled, not what was decided; votes are not in agendas.
item_details_note: districts and named come from the item text in the agenda body (district tag at the end of each item; commissioners named with their title). Automated extraction; see the agenda PDF.
